executiveAssessment.text: The St. Regis Cap Cana Resort currently shows AI Consideration of 46.7% and Scenario Presence of 98.3%, with Reality Coverage at 64.3%. Strongest governed signal: Still developing. Primary constraint: Not appearing consistently in AI answers. Versus the prior published run (2026-09-08), material headline movement is AI Consideration +46.7 pp and Scenario Presence +98.3 pp. Independent Positioning shows #1 of 11 with Portfolio AI Presence 45.6%. Overall Core performance is mixed: some indicators are competitive while others still show material gaps. Management should protect the stronger signals while closing the specific gaps that are already visible in evidence.

secondaryCallout.title: Performance Risk
secondaryCallout.body: The hotel appeared in at least one AI answer for 98.3% of the traveler needs we tested, but across all individual AI answers it appeared 46.7% of the time. In practical terms, AI recognizes the hotel as relevant for many types of trips, but a traveler will not consistently see it among the hotel options surfaced.
